description: Terraform resource types that CANNOT carry a resource label in the google
provider, and are therefore exempt from the managed-by=swarm-terraform rule
that scripts/lib/destroy-guard.jq enforces.
This list lives here, once, because three things read it: scripts/destroy.sh
(make destroy), and the plan guards in .github/workflows/terraform.yml and
release.yml via scripts/lib/plan-guard.sh. It used to be restated in awk in
the workflows, and the copies drifted -- the awk version exempted only
google_project_iam*, so a plan deleting a google_storage_bucket_iam_member
(removing a tenant, or changing a tenant's provider list) was blocked from
production by a rule nobody had decided.
The guard fails CLOSED: a type absent from this list and carrying no label is
an offender, so adding an entry is a deliberate, reviewable act. Every entry
below was checked against `terraform providers schema -json` on 2026-09-16:
none of them has a labels / effective_labels / terraform_labels attribute.
*_iam_member, *_iam_binding and *_iam_policy are NOT listed. They are policy
edges rather than resources, there are dozens of them, and destroy-guard.jq
matches them by SHAPE so a new one is exempt the day it is written.
google_monitoring_alert_policy, _notification_channel and _uptime_check_config
do have a `labels`/`user_labels` attribute, but it is the monitoring product's
own key/value payload (an email address, a filter), not a resource label, so
they are exempt here rather than expected to carry managed-by.
